english.note: Use this when cautious means avoiding risk or making a tentative, non-committal choice.
Use this for an estimate or forecast that deliberately allows for the worst case, as in 保守估計.

examples.english: I want to be cautious with this investment.
examples.jyutping: ni1 ci3 tau4 zi1 ngo5 soeng2 bou2 sau2 di1

examples.english: A pessimistic estimate is that this building will take two years to complete.
examples.traditional: 保守估計，呢幢樓要起兩年先完成。
examples.jyutping: bou2 sau2 gu2 gai3 ne1 tong4 lau4 jiu3 hei2 loeng5 nin4 sin1 jyun4 sing4
